_help: Part library for the ASH Front Plate Builder. All sizes in mm.
Each entry under 'parts' is one part type; its key (e.g. 'btn16') is stored in saved layouts, so don't rename keys that are in use.
name / group / label: shown in the parts list; label is the prefix for auto names (BTN1, BTN2...).

hole: exactly what is cut in the front plate: the whole body for some parts, only the shaft for others (rotary, encoder). For buttons with a deco ring, make it larger than the cap: the deco sleeve fills the gap, so its wall is (hole - cap) / 2.

cap: the element you see and press: button cap, knob, lever, LED. height is only used for the 3D preview. style: button | knob | lever | led. Leave cap out for flush parts like a display. For buttons, the cap passes through the deco ring and sleeve.
pcb: the board or switch body under the plate. depth = how far it reaches behind the plate (checked against Plate spacing).
clearance: safe space around the part. The keep-out zone = the largest of hole, cap and pcb, plus clearance on every side.
keepout (optional): set an exact keep-out shape instead of the computed one.
Every part can be rotated; set rotatable: false to lock one. allowOverNoGo: true lets a part sit over the back plate's no-go areas (it must still avoid mounting holes).
display: true draws a screen in the 3D preview.

counterbore (optional): a wider blind pocket cut from the top of the plate around the hole, e.g. { "shape": "circle", "d": 32, "depth": 1 }. The hole still goes all the way through; at least 0.4 mm of plate is always left under the pocket.
deco: false keeps a part out of the deco: no ring around it (the rotary switch uses this).

row (optional): makes a symmetric row of identical elements, e.g. LEDs. pitch = default centre-to-centre spacing, maxPerSide = how many can be added on each side of the middle one. The part's position is the middle element; the keep-out becomes one rounded strip around the whole row.
